domain.DECISION_COUNT: Choose exactly five measures. Replace one of your selections.
domain.INVALID_ASSUMPTION: Check the cost and delay assumptions.
domain.INVALID_DECISION: Choose a measure and an eligible district.
domain.UNKNOWN_MEASURE: This measure is not in the catalogue.
domain.DUPLICATE_MEASURE: {measureId} is already selected. Each measure can be used once.
domain.DIRECTION_LIMIT: At most two measures per direction. Replace one of them.
domain.EXCLUDED_PAIR: {first} and {second} conflict in this allocation. Change a measure or district.
domain.OVER_BUDGET: Cost {cost} exceeds the budget of {budget}. Choose a lower-cost replacement.
domain.NO_FEASIBLE_PLAN: No feasible plan meets these conditions. Change one constraint.
domain.NURA_REQUIRES_TWO_SOCIAL: Removing both critical indicators in Nura needs two social measures. Relax all-five-direction coverage or allow a critical indicator.

errors.INVALID_PLAN: This plan does not meet the rules. Adjust the highlighted measures.
errors.CONSTRAINT_CONFLICT: These conditions conflict. Adjust one of the highlighted constraints.
errors.STALE_REVISION: This plan changed in another window. Your edits remain here. Compare them with the latest version.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This plan is unavailable. It may have been deleted or belong to another account.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Sign in again or start a new plan.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Wait a little and retry. Your text is preserved.
errors.AI_UNAVAILABLE: Analysis could not start. Try again later; calculations and manual editing remain available.
errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: Analysis took too long. Finished results are saved. Retry your request.
errors.INVALID_AI_RESULT: The explanation failed its evidence check. Calculations are saved; try generating the explanation again.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Changes could not be saved. Your edits remain here. Check your connection and retry.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Check the entered information and try again.
errors.BODY_TOO_LARGE: The request is too large. Shorten the text and retry.
errors.FORBIDDEN: The request was rejected. Open CityBalance in a regular tab and retry.
errors.SCENARIO_LIMIT: Saved plan limit reached. Delete an unused plan or sign in.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Your edits remain here. Check your connection and retry.
